title: Fennel and the Big Peach Shy
subtitle: A story about feeling shy
story: Clover the bunny turned five today,
and Fennel was invited to come and play!
top
He wrapped up a gift in a bow of blue.
“A party!” said Mama. “I’ll go with you.”
top
Balloons! And music! And cake on a plate!
So many faces! Fennel stopped at the gate.
top
A fuzzy peach cloud floated down, soft and slow.
It wrapped around Fennel from head to toe.
top
His voice went tiny. His cheeks felt hot.
He hid behind Mama and stayed on the spot.
top
Mama knelt down. “Shy is okay.
Lots of us feel shy, every day.”
top
“First, WAVE. Just lift your paw up high.
A wave is a way to say a shy hi.”
top
“Next, SAY one small hello.
‘Hi, I’m Fennel.’ Say it soft and slow.”
top
“Last, SHARE. Have something to give.
A toy or a snack helps a friendship live.”
top
Fennel waved a wave, and it wasn’t so bad.
“Hi, I’m Fennel,” he said, feeling glad.
top
He shared his gift. Clover jumped with glee.
“Come play with me!” she said. “Come play with me!”
top
The peach cloud floated off like a feather.
Wave. Say. Share. Make friends together.
top
steps: Lift a paw and wave hello.
Share a toy or a snack.
note_lines: Do not push. Stay close until your child is ready.
Practice a wave and a hello at home.

A warm rhyming story for ages 3–6,

listing.description:
Clover's birthday party is today! But when Fennel gets to the gate, a fuzzy Big Peach Shy floats down and wraps around him.

So many faces! So much noise! His voice goes tiny and his cheeks feel hot, until Mama Bear kneels beside him and shows him how to say hello.

With three friendly steps — Wave. Say. Share. — little readers learn that shy is okay, and that friends are waiting.

Inside this warm rhyming picture book:

  • A cozy read-aloud rhyme for ages 3–6, great before a birthday party or playdate
  • A kid-friendly image of shyness as a soft peach cloud that floats away
  • Three easy steps children can copy: Wave, Say, Share
  • A note for grown-ups with simple ways to support a shy child
  • Soft watercolor-style illustrations

Book 6 in the Fennel's Feelings series. A gentle story for any child who feels shy meeting new friends.
